 Galatasaray and VfB Stuttgart: Recent form
 Galatasaray head into the match in Istanbul with four wins from their last five competitive games. They beat Konyaspor 4-0 in the Süper Lig and won the city derby against Fenerbahçe 2-1. Their only setback was a 4-1 Champions League defeat to Barcelona. Galatasaray scored eight goals and conceded ten over that period.
 VfB Stuttgart have won two of their last five competitive games, most recently beating Bayer Leverkusen 4-2 away in the Bundesliga. They also defeated Paderborn 1-0 in the DFB Cup. Defeats to Gladbach (3-2) and Hamburger SV (1-0), plus a 1-1 Champions League draw with Atlético Madrid, complete their run. Stuttgart scored nine goals and conceded eight over that period.
